ArchivedAudit.title: ArchivedAudit
ArchivedAudit.description: Persisted 6-invariant thermodynamic protocol or commodity audit stored in the shared 0-credit vault.

architecture.description: Architectural summary of consensus, supply, and execution model.

totalScore.description: Sum of all 6 invariant scores between 0.0 and 6.0.

invariants.description: Exact 6-element ordered list of evaluated thermodynamic invariants (01..06).

queryAliases.description: Bounded list of up to 20 search alias strings mapped to this ticker.

archivedInvLogs.description: Map of invariant IDs ('01'..'06') to bounded challenge/breakdown/re-audit log arrays.

sources.description: Optional bounded list of up to 12 Google Search grounding citations.

historicalSnapshots.description: Optional bounded list of up to 16 chronological Time Machine snapshots (tm-1913..tm-present).

auditedAtTimelineYear.description: Optional Time Machine stop identifier indicating the root audit horizon ('1913'..'PRESENT').

isArchived.description: Indicates this audit document is published to the shared vault.

archivedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last archive write.

originalAuthorUid.description: Firebase UID of the verified user who originally archived this document.

archivedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the verified user who performed the latest update.

GainsCohortSnapshot.title: GainsCohortSnapshot
GainsCohortSnapshot.description: Persisted E > 0 vs E = 0 thermodynamic gains cohort asset lists and synced spot price snapshots.

cohortId.description: Lowercase normalized cohort snapshot identifier (e.g. default).

isPublished.description: Indicates this cohort snapshot is published to the shared vault.

isCustomized.description: Whether the cohort list or spot prices have been updated beyond canonical defaults.

sourceLabel.description: Display label describing the latest sync or edit source.

passed.description: Bounded list of up to 60 E > 0 cohort asset entries.

failed.description: Bounded list of up to 60 E = 0 cohort asset entries.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of latest cohort update.

updatedAtLabel.description: Formatted timestamp string for the cohort update.

originalAuthorUid.description: Firebase UID of the verified user who created this cohort snapshot.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the verified user who last updated this cohort snapshot.

/archived_audits/{tickerId}.description: Publicly readable, verified-user writable persistent thermodynamic audit records cached at zero AI credit cost.

/gains_cohorts/{cohortId}.description: Publicly readable, verified-user writable persisted gains cohort lists and live spot price snapshots.
